what: NHC's published average official (OFCL) forecast errors and case counts, 2020-2025, transcribed from NHC's annual error tables. The verifier control of program TC1 (docs/HURRICANE_TRACK_INTENSITY_PROGRAM.md) must reproduce them before any TC1 number is read.

sources.AL_track: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/verification/pdfs/1989-present_OFCL_ATL_annual_trk_errors.pdf (best track as of 5/12/26; homogeneous with best-track CLIPER5; includes subtropical cyclones)
sources.AL_intensity: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/verification/pdfs/1990-present_OFCL_ATL_annual_int_errors.pdf (best track as of 5/18/26; homogeneous with best-track Decay-SHIFOR5; includes subtropical cyclones)
sources.EP_track: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/verification/pdfs/1989-present_OFCL_EPAC_annual_trk_errors.pdf (best track as of 5/18/26; homogeneous with best-track CLIPER5)
sources.EP_intensity: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/verification/pdfs/1990-present_OFCL_EPAC_annual_int_errors.pdf (best track as of 5/18/26; homogeneous with best-track Decay-SHIFOR5)
sources.transcribed: 2026-10-08, from the PDFs' tables; units n mi (track) and kt (intensity); each cell is [error, N]
